matched_rules.because: Storms are active (lightning caused utility voltage swells), a portion of the datacenter transferred from utility to generator power, and mechanical cooling shut down despite surge suppressors.

Mechanical cooling is down and the datacenter is running on its load-dependent thermal buffer; customer impact began when storage servers shut down due to unsafe temperatures, indicating the buffer was depleted and automated shutdowns started.

next_actions.action: Immediately verify that mechanical cooling systems are still running, rather than assuming surge suppressors protected them.
If mechanical cooling has shut down, treat the datacenter as being on a load-dependent thermal buffer and start planning for its depletion.
Transfer the rest of the datacenter to generators to stabilize the power supply while storms are still active.
Treat the thermal buffer as a finite resource and act before it is depleted.
Expect that once the buffer is gone, temperature will exceed safe operational thresholds and automated device shutdown will begin.
Recognize that in parts of the datacenter temperature can rise so quickly that hardware is damaged before it can shut down.

escalate.to: facility operations lead and cooling plant engineer
escalate.reason: Mechanical cooling confirmed shut down while storms remain active in the area.

per_finding.note: R-001 explicitly names power swells shutting down mechanical cooling despite surge suppressors and directs verifying cooling rather than assuming protection.
R-002 states the thermal buffer was depleted and automated shutdowns began once safe temperature thresholds were exceeded.
R-002's next action explicitly recognizes that temperature can rise so quickly that hardware is damaged before it can shut down.
R-001's next action directs transferring the rest of the datacenter to generators while storms are still active.
R-002 anticipates automated device shutdown and hardware damage but does not specify storage servers, network devices, or power units.
The triage does not mention forensic analysis or recovery procedure review.
The triage does not address future hardware design or storage scale unit resiliency.
